card.name: Start of surnames like Small, Long, Hard
card.fires_on: Common English adjectives (Small, Hard, Long, Black, Good) used as the first part of a person's surname in author lists and citations. The word sits right after a first name or initial, and the surname continues on the next piece (Smallwood, Hardy, Longo).

modes.label: Surname in citations
modes.description: Adjective-like surname start in a reference or author list, after initials or a first name.

modes.label: Surname after first name
modes.description: Adjective-like word that begins a full person name in running text or credits.

card.writes: It pushes toward word endings that finish a name or compound, though the promoted tokens are mixed and weakly informative.
card.plain: It notices a plain English word like Small or Long that is really the first part of someone's surname in a reference list.
